problem: The full gpu/CMakeLists.txt was hashed into the shader cache identity; unrelated test targets discarded compatible caches. Effective target options and the Sirit emitter were insufficiently represented.

identity_inputs: Shader translator, GCN decoder, pipeline/cache implementation and shared headers

implementation.compatibility: One intentional migration for the corrected identity. Existing magic, version, shader-build and GPU-profile rejection checks remain unchanged. Incompatible caches must rebuild.

integration_tests: Unrelated test additions, comments and inactive configuration options preserve bytes and mtime
Shader/emitter code, active/inherited/directory/source definitions and compiler options invalidate identity

limits: This addresses unnecessary cache invalidation; it does not establish higher rendering FPS or a global resource minimum.
Target dependencies and hashed source sets must be maintained when new shader compiler dependencies are added.
